QuestInfo.name: First Contact
QuestInfo.0: Ask Kino Konoko, the leader of the Mushroom Shrine, what she knows. Hopefully Oda didn't get to her first...
QuestInfo.1: Kino Konoko and the residents of the Mushroom Shrine are worried by the appearance of all these new armies. Speak with her before the Oda clan has the opportunity.
QuestInfo.2: Kino Konoko directed you to Athena Pierce in Henesys. You can reach Victoria Island via Perry the Pelican or travel directly to Henesys through the Heart or Zipangu.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 9,430\nCan proceed to the Return Orders quest
